name: pantti-auctions-finland
description: Gold and silver alerts for Finnish pawnshop auctions (Helsingin Pantti, Suomen Panttilaina): each auction when it is listed, then 10 h and 30 min before it closes, with lots valued by weight and fineness at spot and the most to bid. Phone messages via ntfy. Runs from the system scheduler, no server.

scripts.test: node --test test/pantti.test.js test/panttilaina.test.js test/agent.test.js test/state.test.js test/http.test.js
